Mathematics BA at UC Berkeley

What UC Berkeley asks of applicants to Mathematics BA for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All UC Berkeley courses · Mathematics field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Test-free: SAT/ACT scores are not used in any part of admission
  • Submitted scores are used only for placement or subject credit after admission
Verified19 Oct 2026UC Berkeley: First-Year Policies
English language
  • English proficiency must be shown by January 31 (international applicants)
  • Stated minimums: TOEFL 90 (or 4.5 on the new scale), IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115
  • Also met by 3+ years of English-language instruction, or set AP/IB English or ACT/SAT English scores

Berkeley lists AP English (3+), IB English A (SL 6–7, HL 5–7), ACT ELA 24+ or SAT Writing and Language 31+ as other ways to show proficiency — even though SAT/ACT scores are not used for admission review. Scores must be valid for 2 years from the enrollment date.

Verified19 Oct 2026UC Berkeley: Requirements for International Students
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Berkeley’s minimum requirements are the A–G subjects and A–G GPA; no admissions test is required (Berkeley is test-free).

Verified19 Oct 2026UC Berkeley: First-Year Requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official (UC A–G subject requirements): History/Social Science 2 years; English 4 years; Mathematics 3 years; Laboratory Science 2 years; Language other than English 2 years; Visual & Performing Arts 1 year; College-preparatory elective 1 year; plus a 3.0 GPA in A–G courses in grades 10–11 (3.4 for non-residents). The year counts are quoted from Berkeley Engineering’s campus page because admissions.berkeley.edu links to the UC A–G guide rather than listing them; they are the UC-wide pattern, not engineering-specific.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UC Berkeley: First-Year Requirements · Berkeley Engineering: Get ready to apply – freshman
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
Completion of the two-year A-level programme with at least three academic exams meets Berkeley’s secondary-study requirement (IGCSE/O-levels alone do not). A-Level results are submitted for the official record once admitted.
Verified19 Oct 2026UC Berkeley: Requirements for International Students
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
The IB Diploma programme meets Berkeley’s secondary-study requirement for international applicants. IB exam scores are not required but are used as “value added” if submitted.
Verified19 Oct 2026UC Berkeley: Requirements for International Students · UC Berkeley: Application FAQs
Other qualifications
  • AP (and IB) exam scores: not required; used as “value added” in review if submitted
Verified19 Oct 2026UC Berkeley: Application FAQs
Other requirements
  • UC Personal Insight Questions: answer 4 of 8 (max 350 words each)
  • No interviews (alumni or admissions officer); InitialView materials optional for international applicants
  • Letters of recommendation: by invitation only, voluntary
  • Portfolios and unsolicited supplemental materials are not accepted
